authority: DESIGN ONLY — NOT EXECUTED in Stage 1. Specifies how a future Stage 2 baseline competition would compare candidate targets fairly and leakage-free. Reuses existing infrastructure (arch_competition eval manifest + lineage) and names the missing temporal-discipline pieces that MUST be built before Stage 2 runs.

eligible_targets.rule: only target_registry_v1 entries with promotion_status == VALID_FOR_EXPERIMENT are eligible as target definitions; CANDIDATE targets require implementation + causal-contract proof (a passing tests/test_stage1_causal_label_contract.py case) to become eligible

economic_targets: mean post-cost return (must be > 0 after costs)

splits_and_leakage_control.temporal_split: walk-forward, out-of-time; train windows strictly precede test windows by ts_utc
splits_and_leakage_control.purge: REQUIRED — drop training rows whose label window overlaps any test anchor (overlapping 1m horizon labels leak without purge)
splits_and_leakage_control.embargo: REQUIRED — embargo gap >= max horizon (60 bars) between train and test to remove serial-correlation leakage
splits_and_leakage_control.session_splits: rth-only primary; premarket/afterhours as explicit transfer experiments (never silently pooled)
splits_and_leakage_control.time_of_day_splits: open / midday / close cohorts reported separately (microstructure differs)
splits_and_leakage_control.MISSING_TODAY: arch_competition/ implements single-window OOS + half-split stability only; purge/embargo/walk-forward are NOT implemented and MUST be built before Stage 2

costs: every economic comparison names a cost_model_registry_v1 id; a target that cannot beat baselines AFTER costs is not advanced
baselines_required: shuffle_control (labels permuted — must score at chance)
calibration: reliability + ECE per cohort; regime-conditional calibration (arch_competition.metrics supports climatology-baseline Brier skill, ECE/MCE, regime-conditional bins)
confidence_intervals: bootstrap CIs on the primary metric; report CI overlap vs baselines
sample_requirements: MIN_SAMPLES_STATISTICAL floor per cell (arch_competition eval_runner:190); movement labels currently cover ~9.1% of governed rows -> insufficient until backfilled
latency_budget: any target whose live scoring path exceeds the production inference budget is disqualified regardless of offline lift
reproducibility: each run pins scheduler_run_manifest lineage (feature_cache_key / data_fingerprint / training_code_fingerprint / ml_horizon_suffix / schema_version) per arch_competition/lineage.py; evaluation_manifest schema v1
simplicity_penalty: ties broken toward the simpler model; a complex model must beat a simple baseline by more than the CI to be preferred
stop_conditions: no candidate target beats the simple baselines AFTER costs -> STOP (do not advance any target)
shuffle_control scores above chance -> STOP (leakage present, fix before continuing)
movement/economic label coverage below the sample floor -> STOP pending backfill
purge/embargo/walk-forward not implemented -> Stage 2 MUST NOT run
explicitly_not_in_scope: SVR / zero-shot / foundation-model production inference (foundation-model is a recorded exclusion)
